context_requirements: Functional glutamate signaling or glutamate transport machinery
Expression of the specific target channels/transporters in the assayed cell line
Neuronal or excitable-cell context for many targets, which is absent in the nine lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that matches known glutamate receptor or transporter pathway activation
Evidence of target engagement in these non-neuronal lines, such as changes in SLC1A2 or potassium/sodium channel target genes
